capabilities: OPE, policy selection and distributional evaluation
limitation: Snapshot last push in 2024; no generic hidden-confounding guarantee
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Logged trajectories, behavior/target probabilities, horizon/discount and optional Q/occupancy nuisance estimates.
scientific_qualification.output: Estimator-specific expected return, return distribution or policy-selection criterion with selected uncertainty routine.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Exchangeability/sufficient information, support, nuisance and sampling conditions for the chosen trajectory or marginal estimator.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Retain trajectory versus occupancy ratios and return-distribution versus mean targets. Interval-method availability does not establish coverage under hidden logging or arbitrary dependence.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Compare trajectory enumeration, IS and DR on a finite MDP; introduce a private logger and rare informative paths; assess bias and interval coverage by regime.

evidence.finding: Offline-RL workflow, trajectory/marginal/DR estimators, confidence routines and selection criteria.
